            <title><![CDATA[What to expect as Hurricane Isaias bears down on the Gulf Coast as a major storm]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/what-to-expect-as-hurricane-isaias-bears-down-on-the-gulf-coast-as-a-major-storm</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Hurricane Isaias has strengthened into a Category 3 hurricane as it heads toward the Gulf Coast. Residents are rushing to prepare for the storm, which is packing winds up to 120 mph and is expected to make landfall Friday night. Amna Nawaz speaks with Michael Brennan, director of the National Hurricane Center, for more.]]></description>

            <title><![CDATA[ICE shooting of man in New York with child in his car sparks outrage]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/ice-shooting-of-man-in-new-york-with-child-in-his-car-sparks-outrage</link>
            <description><![CDATA[An investigation is underway after U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents shot a man in New York City Thursday. Federal authorities say 28-year-old Oscar Belgal attempted to ram officers with his vehicle when they tried to detain him. ICE agents then fired at his car, where a young child was in the back seat. William Brangham reports.]]></description>

            <title><![CDATA[News Wrap: Trump announces diesel deal with Russia]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/news-wrap-trump-announces-diesel-deal-with-russia</link>
            <description><![CDATA[In our news wrap Friday, Trump says he struck a deal with Russia for millions of tons of diesel in a bid to lower U.S. energy prices, Katie Zacharia will replace Karoline Leavitt as White House press secretary, the Pentagon's plans to livestream an execution has drawn strong reactions, Trump launched a new effort to fire Fed governor Lisa Cook, and NFL legend Mike Ditka died at age 86.]]></description>

            <title><![CDATA[Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize after long career of investigating war crimes]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/navi-pillay-wins-nobel-peace-prize-after-long-career-of-investigating-war-crimes</link>
            <description><![CDATA[International human rights lawyer Navi Pillay won the Nobel Peace Prize on Friday. The Nobel Committee said it chose her as "institutions of international law are under political attack." Hours later, the Trump administration sanctioned the International Criminal Court, where Pillay was a judge. Nick Schifrin speaks with Stephen Rapp for more on Pillay's legacy and responses to the announcement.]]></description>

            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/how-local-officials-are-testing-voting-machines-to-ensure-election-integrity</link>

            <description><![CDATA[Actor Ke Huy Quan went from arriving in America as a refugee to starring in Indiana Jones and The Goonies. Decades later, he made an Oscar-winning comeback.             <title><![CDATA[Time for term limits? Dems in majority could have familiar faces in key roles]]></title>
            <link>https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/time-for-term-limits-dems-in-majority-could-have-familiar-faces-in-key-roles</link>
            <description><![CDATA[Democrats hope to bring a new agenda to the House next year if they take the majority, but they will most likely do so with many of the same faces that have steered their party's legislative work for a decade or more.]]></description>
            <pubDate>Fri, 09 Oct 2026 14:05:30 -0400</pubDate>
